notif-example-01.title: Calendar Module Is Live
notif-example-01.body: Lawyers can now view, add, and manage appointments directly from the portal. Real-time sync is included — changes reflect immediately across all sessions.

notif-example-02.title: Inline CMS Editor Updated
notif-example-02.body: The content editor now supports undo history, live preview, and keyboard shortcuts. Press Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+S to save.

notif-example-03.title: Scheduled Maintenance — May 2nd
notif-example-03.body: The portal will be briefly unavailable on May 2nd between 02:00 – 03:00 AM MST for infrastructure upgrades. No action required.
